notes.title: Major Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Village Leaders! 

The premiere of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder is just around the corner but before it happens we’d like to treat you to yet another update in the Prologue version! 💪

This is the fruit of your feedback and our hard work in providing even better gameplay experience than before. 

Without further ado, we hope that the changes we bring will make for a nice appetizer for what’s to come in just a few days! 👍


chore: introduction of a new area of range so that it is visible above the trees.
chore: introduction of the ability to reconfigure the keyboard to the options.
chore: adding an indicator to show paused buildings.
chore: adding more UI animations.
chore: further optimization
chore: changes to gameplay balance.
bugfix: sometimes buildings do not detect that they have been connected to a road.
bugfix: tooltips don't always work.
bugfix: crash when very many roads have been built.
bugfix: temple residents stay in the same place after moving a building.
bugfix: deposits are not highlighted.
bugfix: when there are a lot of warehouses on the map then the game freezes.
bugfix: sometimes the game freezes for a few seconds.
bugfix: corrections in translations


See you soon,
El Dorado: The Golden City Builder Team

notes.title: The release date has been changed
notes.notes:
Dea Players,

We have decided to postpone the premiere of El Dorado: The Golden City Builder.

The game will be released in Q2 2024.

This decision was made to give us more time to put the final touches and ensure the best quality of both the gameplay and localization which for some reasons beyond our control got slightly delayed. 

Thank you for your understanding. 🤝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png

See you soon,
El Dorado Team

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Dear Players❣️

It's been 4 days since Steam Next Fest started 📅Many of you are interested in our game which makes us very happy!

During these four days we’ve spent a lot of time watching your streams, browsing our discord and discussing on Steam 👀 We got a lot of feedback from you regarding our game El Dorado: The Golden City Builder from all around the world 🌍 We tried to learn as much as we could from them and took into account every single suggestion you gave us, even the smallest one. 📝


We will be able to implement some of the changes you suggested only in the later stages of development such as the Prologue or Full version of the game but we wanted to add something new for you now as well! ⏳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/6c75b6990002f09a2af1fb2d244d02cc1c4ef18f.png



One of the changes we've made is a new look for the Festivals you organize during the game in honor of the Gods!


Until now, the mechanics of organizing a festival did not change the appearance of the temple in any way and nothing happened on it 😥.
Now, with the latest update we have added the festival animation! 🎊
At the top of the temple you built, right next to the sacrificial table, the Archpriest will show up to perform the entire sacred ritual ✨
His task, as it historically was - will be to make a sacrifice to God hoping to win his favor. How will he perform this task? Well, we think the gif inserted in this post explains everything 😀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/ec28b0ff5cdea9608eb2b9905c7f087899183272.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/3e7b59c87553f75102056aa2261cf0cfbc0192f6.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/15fd45153deb5cb9dc237cefe2e19dd705905df5.gif

In addition to the Archpriest, the people of our village will also cheer on the temple, giving us an amazing spectacle!



Pach notes: 


 Flickering weather bug fixed




We hope that this small change will make the gameplay much more enjoyable for you 👏
We still invite you to join us at Steam Next Fest and play our game El Dorado: The Golden City Builder! 

Join our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39052778/5d85522441c744d2eea4300ae6a297bb196c2da2.png


See You Soon,
El Dorado Team
